🪺 TileMosaic

Colored tiles must be placed into a grid to recreate a target mosaic pattern. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Study the target mosaic pattern.
  2. Drag tiles from the palette into the grid positions.
  3. Each tile has a specific color and goes in a specific grid cell.
  4. Match the pattern exactly — position and color both matter.
  5. Some puzzles have symmetrical patterns that can help you work faster.
